name: Monthly customer voice keeper
why: Checks each month's new reviews for buyer words and doubts, a steady input to the voice of the customer programme.

name: Survey answer truth checker
why: Scores how far a survey can be trusted before acting on it, matching the base-first reading in the survey programme skill.

name: Check a marketing survey before sending it
why: Catches leading and confusing questions before a survey goes out, the step before publishing at level 3.

name: Prepare a survey findings briefing
why: Turns survey results into a short briefing, a companion to the quarterly CX report prompt.

name: Complaint reply promise checker
why: Finds promises a reply cannot back and defensive lines, a useful check on any formal complaint reply draft before approval.

name: Get a stuck customer issue unstuck and close the loop
why: Builds the facts, an escalation brief and a reply for one stuck case, the individual side of closing the loop.

name: Hard-to-use thing diagnoser
why: Finds why people keep getting something wrong and the smallest fix, close to the behaviour barrier diagnosis skill.

name: Make every touchpoint say the same thing
why: Ranks where touchpoints disagree, the clash check in the touchpoint inventory prompt.

name: Customer onboarding keeper
why: Watches which onboarding step loses new customers each week, a live feed for the customer path map.

name: Support bot error reviewer
why: Finds wrong answers in support bot chats against approved help text, part of the AI disclosure and quality check.

name: Interview customers and map what they hire you to do
why: Gathers interview evidence about what customers are trying to get done, the evidence a customer path map needs.

name: Turn your plan into guesses and test them with customers
why: Turns assumptions into small tests, the same discipline as writing every behaviour change idea as a test.
